summary: Recognize preferred Fractal seat identities in boot-canary process discovery and replacement fences

replay.detail: Canary process inspection only; no replay change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule change.

compatibility.detail: Boot canaries read FRACTAL_AGENT before legacy ST_AGENT, retain legacy-only compatibility, exclude conflicting identities from process selection, and let an explicitly empty preferred identity mask the legacy alias. Exact ST3_ENDPOINT ownership, pidfd signaling checks, and ST3_INCARNATION replacement fences remain unchanged; no runtime or wire identifier change.
